name: AR RolePilot for WooCommerce
author: Ariful Razib

sections.description:
AR RolePilot for WooCommerce automatically assigns WordPress user roles when customers purchase specific WooCommerce products. Simply assign a role to a product, choose the order status that triggers the role update, and let RolePilot handle the rest.

Features include:

  • Assign WordPress roles to WooCommerce customers.
  • Set different roles for different products.
  • Automatically assigns roles when an order reaches the selected status (Processing or Completed).
  • Supports simple and variable products.
  • Easy-to-use admin interface.
  • Compatible with the latest WooCommerce versions.
  • Translation ready.
  • Lightweight and optimized.

Perfect for:

  • Membership websites
  • Online course websites
  • Wholesale stores
  • Digital product stores
  • B2B WooCommerce stores
  • Private customer groups
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Open AR RolePilot for WooCommerce settings.
  5. Configure role assignments for your products.
  6. Save your settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Does it work with existing customers?

Yes. Existing customers will receive the configured role when they purchase a product that has a role assigned and the order reaches the selected status.

Can different products assign different roles?

Yes.

Does it support variable products?

Yes.

Does the plugin remove old roles?

Only according to the selected configuration.

Can I choose when the role is assigned?

Yes. You can configure the plugin to assign the selected role when an order reaches either the Processing or Completed status.
